market_summary: Broad risk-off and USD strength dominate the session, leaving gold, euro, pound, and bitcoin severely depressed below their daily VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Areas. However, all four are currently in low-volume consolidation or weak mean-reversion pauses near their respective session lows. Meanwhile, US100 rallied into positive gamma territory but was immediately capped and rejected at Call Wall #1 (28428.83). All setups currently lack fresh trigger confluence or clean risk locations, dictating a selective HOLD across the board.
